shellCommands.command: git diff && git ls-files | grep -v node_modules | head -100 && cat package.json

cd /workspace; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cd /workspace/node_modules/next; ls; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_prefetch\|prefetch=\"" --include=*.md* . 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; cat 01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md; ls 01-app/02-guides | grep -i static; cat 01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md 2>/dev/null | head -80

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -n -i "app shell\|navigation stages" docs/01-app/glossary.md 2>/dev/null | head; ls docs/01-app; grep -rln "export function prefetch\|function prefetch()" server/ 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -n -i -A6 "## App Shell\|## Navigation stages\|## Static shell" docs/01-app/04-glossary.md; cat server/request/cache-stages.js | head -200
cd /workspace; cat tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls; git status --short

cd /workspace; for f in .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc; do echo "== $f"; grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products\|Premium Widget" $f | sort | uniq -c; done; echo "== html"; grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products" .next/server/app/product.html | sort | uniq -c
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -rn "RenderStage = \|RenderStage\[" server/app-render/staged-rendering.js | head -30; grep -rln "prefetchApi\|PrefetchStatic" client/ | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; ls client/components/segment-cache/; grep -rn -i "stage" client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head -60

cd /workspace/.next/server/app/product.segments; for f in product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc _full.segment.rsc; do echo "== $f size $(wc -c <$f)"; grep -o '"a":"\$@[0-9a-f]*"' $f; grep -bo "Compact Widget\|Loading related\|^1[0-9a-f]:\[[0-9,]*\]" $f; done; sed -n 1,400p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | grep -n "AppStage" | head -5; grep -n "AppStage\[" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/types.js
cd /workspace; git diff tsconfig.json; git checkout tsconfig.json; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts; git status --short; git diff app
